_doc: CHUNK-VALUE-1110 WP1: thresholds, heading lists and word lists for vera/chunk_value.py (pure rules module shared by the ingest filter and the known-bad audit). Every value that decides keep/drop lives here; the module holds only rule-id names. 'enabled' is read by the caller (WP2), not by the module; it ships false (V2: the owner turns ingest filtering on). Thresholds in 'document.incomprehensible' were calibrated on the 11 local real JATS documents (work/CHUNK-VALUE-1110/measure.md): each sits beyond the worst known-good value plus a margin; recalibrate on the audit's own distribution before any purge.

C5_low_info._note: a chunk whose non-space characters are at least this share digits or symbols (equations, tables) is never low-info or near-dup (C5 and C6 skip it); tokens are Unicode letters

D1_portal_sourced._note: REPROV-W3-1110 + PVFIX-A-1110: port of fulltext_loader.portal_verdict; policy is a copy of config/host_roles.json at source_commit (PVFIX-A-1110 on d3fe0fe content; minus _doc and pending_decisions). Labels are not the binding: the pin of this file is.

D2_incomprehensible._note: severity: a D2 hit is 'purge' only for text detected as English (marker-word share) and not math-heavy; otherwise 'review'. The dictionary metric runs only on detected-English text.

D3_incomplete._note: too-few-spans: fires when no substantive chunk remains (doc_min_chunks=1), or, for documents of >= share_check_min_chunks chunks, when fewer than doc_min_substantive_share of them survive the C rules. Short legitimate documents (1-9 chunks) are judged by body_chars_min instead.
